text: Re-triage the open requests against what has landed since 2026-10-23 (decision 7A applies again): several are already done, such as 'Count recorded check results as commands that ran for D43 evidence' (52ad42d) and parts of 'Add disk-space guard and target/ cleanup' (173d12e), and others are superseded by the records-history design (D111), such as the squash preflight and trailer-based checks. For each open request, keep it, close it as done naming the commit, or close it as superseded naming what replaced it, each with a reason, using athena close. Acceptance: athena plan afterwards lists only requests that still matter, and each closed one has a recorded reason.
